```{python}
import polars as pl
import numpy as np
import io
import requests
import urllib3
from lets_plot import *

LetsPlot.setup_html(isolated_frame=True)
```

```{python}
url = "https://posit.byui.edu/content/0d43d66f-d3b7-4c43-8c36-52e3ed69e7f1/names_year_csv.csv"

response = requests.get(url, verify=False)
response.raise_for_status()

df = pl.read_csv(io.BytesIO(response.content))
```


```{python}
elliot = df.filter((pl.col("name") == "Elliot"), (pl.col("year") >= 1950))

elliot_plot = (
    ggplot(data = elliot, mapping = aes(x = "year", y = "Total", color = "name"))
    +geom_line()
    +scale_x_continuous(format = 'd', breaks = list(range(1950, 2023, 10)), expand =[0,0])
    +scale_y_continuous(format = 'd')
    +labs(title = "Elliot...What?", y="")
    +scale_color_manual(values={"Elliot": "blue"})
    +geom_vline(xintercept = 1982, color = "Red", linetype = 2)
    +geom_vline(xintercept = 1985, color = "Red", linetype = 2)
    +geom_vline(xintercept = 2002, color = "Red", linetype = 2)
    +geom_text(x = 1981, y = 3000, label = "E.T. Released", size = 6, hjust = 1, color = "Black")
    +geom_text(x = 1986, y = 3000, label = "Second Release", size = 6, hjust = 0, color = "Black")
    +geom_text(x = 2003, y = 3000, label = "Third Release", size = 6, hjust = 0, color = "Black")
    +theme_gray()
    +theme(
        text = element_text(family = "serif"),
        legend_justification = "top",
        plot_title_position = "plot",
        panel_grid_minor = element_blank()
    )
    +ggsize(800,400)
)

elliot_plot
```
